Name: Convenient Inventory Cherry Blossom UI
Author: IkarosHDD
Description:
This a re-color of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10384]Convenient Inventory[/url] by gaussfire, by default it's only uses vanilla colors.

However I really like how [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25141]Cherry Blossom UI[/url] looks and unfortunately barely any mods are compatible with it, so I took it upon myself to recolor it to work together.

If and at any time, if gaussfire wishes me to take down this mod I will do so.

I've Only changed background of the mismatched colors of the UI, it's very possible I missed some spots here and there so please do let me know if you find them.﻿

[size=5][color=pink]~Mod Description~[/color]
[/size]
- Changes Inventory Buttons to match Cherry Blossom UI
- Changes Favorites Highlight to better match Cherry Blossom UI

[size=5][color=pink]~Updates~[/color]

[/size]- None Yet.

[size=5][color=pink]~Installation~[/color]

[size=3]1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10384]Convenient Inventory
[/url]2. Download this mod
3. Inside \assets folder of this mod copy and replace contents into ﻿\assets folder of Convenient Inventory
[/size][size=3]4. Enjoy!
[/size]
[/size]
